review.intent_summary: Readable CLI output distinguishes point episodes, pattern findings, cases, explicit rule violations, and reference readiness.

criteria.criterion: Point-anomaly episode counts and residual-pattern findings are labeled separately.
Relationship cases identify entity scope, observed and expected values, declared units, and investigation questions.
Explicit numerical rules are named with their boundaries instead of appearing as statistical anomaly claims.
Readiness status remains visible, including when it was not assessed.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Read conversion and unit-cost stdout: entity/unit labels, observed versus expected conversion, named 0.13 unit-cost boundary, investigation questions and not_assessed readiness remain clear.
